config.note: teastore-db scaled to 0 while the order confirm executes. DESIGN: persistence's OrderRepository.createEntity has no catch - the create fails 500 at the REST layer; the registryclient chain (NonBalancedCRUDOperations: non-404/408 -> silent -1L; placeOrder never checks) then masks it into the order-confirmed page, exactly as MEASURED for the maintenance (201/-1) and mesh-sever (503) producers on the same site. ground_truth.label: positive
ground_truth.rationale: The third producer of the SAME natural masked-write site (TeaStore order confirm): with the backing database down, the persistence create fails (OrderRepository.createEntity, no catch -> 500), the registryclient swallows the non-404/408 status to -1L, placeOrder never checks it, and the webui renders the order-confirmed page - the user is told success while nothing durable exists. The mask is the measured, source-grounded -1L chain (captured live for the maintenance and mesh-sever producers on this exact site); only the PRODUCER differs. NORM: same as the captured twin (the webui ships an order-history profile as the durable record; the documented degraded mode is refusal, not silent acceptance).
ground_truth.doc_citation: DescartesResearch/TeaStore v1.4.2: persistence OrderRepository.createEntity (no catch; DB-down -> 500); registryclient NonBalancedCRUDOperations (non-404/408 -> -1L); auth placeOrder (unchecked). Survey: debug/a-main/c2c3/c2-depth-survey.md (TeaStore §1 + the 2026-07-10 live-verification corrections block).

provenance.notes: LIVE-CAPTURED 2026-07-20 (kind 'mist'): the PVC CAPTURE PRECONDITION below was MET (teastore-db patched with a local-path PVC mounted at /var/lib/mysql; deploy-shape change ONLY, SUT image byte-untouched) and the pair captured. RESULT = acknowledged-but-LOST confirmed: the webui MASKS the persistence DB-down as a successful order (confirm HTTP 302, order-confirmed redirect, no error page) while the order is never durably persisted. Control (db up) 302 -> GET /rest/orders PRESENT (a control order stayed durable across all db-down cycles via the PVC = the absence is 'this order lost', NOT 'db wiped'); fault (teastore-db verified 0 pods at confirm) 302 -> /rest/orders ABSENT, N=6 over 2 independent db-down cycles, /rest/orders row-count unchanged. Read-back surface = GET /rest/orders (persistence JPA JSON, the SAME durable surface as the mesh-sever twins => mist_bindable=TRUE, superseding the earlier design-cell assumption of 'api-get HTML modality/mist_bindable=false'; so the mist_readback cell is now a real FLAG candidate, not not_applicable — E2 re-score is an owed follow-up, not done in this edit). DISCLOSED CAPTURABILITY NUANCE (honest): the LOSS is deterministic ONLY under a buffer-drop protocol — force-delete the persistence pod WHILE the DB is down (dropping the JPA connection-pool's buffered write) BEFORE restoring the DB; naive scale-cycles show ~50% pool-reconnect-flush persistence (the ACK 302-masked is INVARIANT either way; only durable persistence varies). Evidence: debug/a-main/benchmark/b4/cset/teastore-depdown/depdown-legs.log. R1 REPORTING UPDATED: this row moves from '+1 specified' INTO the captured positive count. | ORIGINAL SPECIFIED RATIONALE (historical, PVC precondition now MET): WAVE-3A ITEM 2b (plan rev 2.1, unanimous-accept b0b5a54; the C-M4 min-3-floor fix): a case - designed, label known by construction, originally NOT captured, and per the freeze rev-2.1 R2/R3 discipline its oracle_expectation was a DESIGN TARGET never tallied as a result. WHY SPECIFIED (the in-file capturability disclosure): the DB-down producer is source-true and was live-ATTEMPTED during Phase C discovery (2026-07-10) - the db scale-cycle measurably WIPED AND REGENERATED the store (product 42 -> 404; the no-PVC emptyDir-equivalent shape), which destroys exactly the absence evidence this case's read-back turns on, so capturing it on THIS deploy shape would be unsound (the survey's live-verification corrections block records the finding). CAPTURE PRECONDITION: a PVC-backed teastore-db (deploy-shape change only; no SUT modification) - under it the standard pair discipline applies (fresh user logged in pre-fault per B-m3, since login reads REQUIRE the db, unlike the maintenance producer where reads pass; db scale 0 -> confirm -> restore -> post-restore read-back). DESIGN-TARGET CELLS: ack columns no_flag (the -1L chain's confirmed page, as MEASURED on the same site for maintenance 201/-1 and mesh-sever 503); trace cells not_applicable (the SUT ships Kieker only - the 2.5.3 exclude branch, same as the captured twins); mist_readback not_applicable (T9 boundary: api-get HTML modality, mist_bindable=false at the pinned commit) with the T1-preserved FLAG design target (marker row absent under a clean ack). ROLE: TeaStore's min-3 mechanism floor points at THREE corpus rows - flag (CAPTURED, teastore-order-maintenance-masked-001), mesh-sever (CAPTURED, teastore-order-meshsever-masked-001), dependency-down (THIS row: specified-with-disclosed-capturability). This case contributes NO site (same order-confirm site) and NO capture-count: reported per the R1 rule as '+1 specified', never inside the captured pos/neg counts.
